definitions.explanation: The act of restraining, subduing, or keeping something down by force. Used for political oppression, psychological repression, or forceful control.

examples.japanese: ⟦{感情|かんじょう}→感情：00171_kanjou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抑圧|よくあつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{政権|せいけん}→政権：12883_seiken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{反対派|はんたいは}→反対派：30532_hantaiha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抑圧|よくあつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧{抑圧|よくあつ}⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧きた⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧⟦{蘇|よみがえ}った→蘇る：04004_yomigaeru⟧。
examples.english: Memories that had been repressed for years suddenly resurfaced.

notes:
USAGE: {抑圧|よくあつ} has both political/social and psychological meanings. In psychology, it refers to the unconscious pushing down of unacceptable thoughts or memories.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{感情|かんじょう}→感情：00171_kanjou⟧/⟦{欲望|よくぼう}→欲望：05086_yokubou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抑圧|よくあつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to repress emotions/desires)
- {抑圧|よくあつ}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧ (repressed memories)
- {抑圧|よくあつ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{解放|かいほう}→解放：00135_kaihou⟧ (liberation from oppression)
